mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.1% indicates an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns remain negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS <= 0.1% (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 6.5% signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 40% of instances where UNRATE <= 6.5% (Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year window).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous GDP growth acceleration (GDPC1 > 1.5% YoY) and housing starts expansion (HOUST > 1.0% YoY) indicate robust consumer demand, generating positive equity returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST exceed thresholds (IC < 0.02).

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), a decline to CPIAUCSL <= 2.5% YoY signals cooling price pressures that reduces recession risk and produces positive SPX returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 55% of triggered instances (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls growth exceeding 100,000 monthly additions signals sustained job market strength that supports consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 45% of instances where PAYEMS > 100,000 (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100.0 (index) signals weakening manufacturing output, increasing recession risk and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 55% of instances where INDPRO < 100.0 (IC < 0.01).

mechanism_narrative: Joint acceleration in real consumption (RSAFS > 0.5% YoY) and housing starts (HOUST > 1.0% YoY) above 6-month moving averages indicates strong aggregate demand, generating positive SPX returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances where both series exceed 6m_ma (IC < 0.02).

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and rising), a decline to FEDFUNDS <= 4.0% signals policy shift to accommodation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).
